import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for event data. INVITATION_FORMAT = """

{event_title}

{event_description}

Date: {event_date}

{additional_notes}
""" def create_event_invitation(title: str, description: str, date: str, notes: str) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML representation of an event invitation. Parameters ---------- title : str Title or name of the event. description : str Comprehensive description of the event (may include multiple paragraphs and formatting). date : str Scheduled date of the event. notes : str Supplementary information or instructions provided by the event organizer. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML string ready for display. """ # Sanitize each user-provided field to neutralize any HTML or script injection. safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True) safe_date = html.escape(date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(notes, quote=True) # Use a mapping for format_map to avoid accidental string interpolation of user data. invitation = INVITATION_FORMAT.format_map({ "event_title": safe_title, "event_description": safe_description, "event_date": safe_date, "additional_notes": safe_notes }) return invitation.strip()
